chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Hadeed, from Mansour ibn Yunus, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
The one who prays an Obligatory Salat and follows up to another, so he is a guest of Allah, and has a right upon Allah that He be Benevolent with His guest.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for performing an obligatory prayer followed immediately by another?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this hadith from al-Kafi highlights the spiritual merit of *muwābaqah* (immediate succession) in prayer, transforming the act into a state of divine hospitality. It underscores the concept that consistent devotion obligates Allah’s generosity, reinforcing the believer's reliance on divine grace (*karām*) rather than mere ritual completion.
